document.title: Sam Rivera — Staff Engineer (Split Entry Fixture)

summary: Platform engineer with over eight years of experience building scalable backend microservices, resilient event streaming pipelines, and automated developer infrastructure. Passionate about domain-driven design and observability.

bullets: Architected enterprise real-time streaming pipeline processing over 50,000 events/second using Kafka and TypeScript microservices.
Engineered transactional outbox pattern implementation, ensuring zero event loss across distributed relational database partitions.
Decreased average end-to-end event delivery latency from 1.2s to 45ms through binary serialization and connection pooling.
Authored system-wide automated performance benchmarking suite integrated into nightly regression test suites.
Spearheaded cloud cost optimization initiative that reduced infrastructure expenditure by $350k annually.
Mentored team of 12 software engineers across two autonomous platform engineering squads.
Collaborated with product security teams to implement automated vulnerability scanning across all container registries.
Formulated technical disaster recovery runbooks and conducted quarterly game-day tabletop outage simulations.
Constructed high-availability RESTful web services in TypeScript and Node.js serving 12M monthly active users.
Redesigned core relational database schema with zero downtime, eliminating deadlocks during peak flash sales.
Engineered distributed caching layer reducing latency across core lookup endpoints by 60%.
Implemented high-throughput packet processing pipelines in Go and C++ handling 5M requests daily.
Built automated integration test harness executing nightly performance regressions on real cluster topologies.
Implemented distributed block replication layer with checksumming and background scrubbing in C++.
Refactored RPC dispatch loop reducing memory overhead per concurrent connection by 45%.
Configured continuous integration pipelines with automated fuzz testing for network serialization protocols.
Developed customer management REST endpoints using Python, PostgreSQL, and Django.
Integrated Redis caching layer to offload high-traffic authentication verification requests.
